Turkey Rice Bowls
$8.10 recipe / $2.03 serving
Servings 4
INGREDIENTS
1 cup long grain white rice ($0.40)
1 lb. ground turkey ($4.99)
1 1.25-ounce package taco seasoning ($0.89)
1 15oz. can black beans ($0.79)
1 ½ pounds ground turkey*
4 oz. cheddar cheese ($1.25)
1 1/3 cups salsa ($1.29)
2 green onions ($0.20)
INSTRUCTIONS
Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Brown the turkey, add the seasoning and 1/2 cup water, and simmer until saucy.
Divide everything between four containers.
